blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Consumers in the Visayas may face power outages on Wednesday as the grid operator declared another red alert due to a tight electricity supply and high demand. In an advisory, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) said the red alert would be in effect from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m., while a yellow alert would be in effect from 6 p.m. to 7 p.m. READ: Groups to DOE chief: Quit over Visayas power woes The Visayas grid is getting limited power imports from Mindanao as some power plants were offline.
